definitions.explanation: An ability or quality given by nature or heaven rather than acquired through effort. Literary, most often seen in the fixed phrase {天賦|てんぷ}の{才|さい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天賦|てんぷ}がある。
examples.english: He has a natural gift for music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧だけでなく{天賦|てんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧だった。
examples.english: Not just hard work but also natural talent was a reason for his success.

notes:
{天賦|てんぷ} literally means "bestowed by heaven" (⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧ heaven + {賦|ふ} bestow); it almost always appears as {天賦|てんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{才|さい} or {天賦|てんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧, "a heaven-given talent."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天賦|てんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{才|さい}: a natural-born talent
- {天賦|てんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: an innate gift

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧: talent, ability in general — the everyday word
- {天賦|てんぷ}: talent framed as a gift from heaven — more literary, used to emphasize that it was never learned
